`final class NodeKeyEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeInputEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeKeyEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeKeyEvent.java)

The event of `handleKeyPressed` and `handleKeyReleased` on a node, with the key that the layout names and its place on the keyboard.

## Description

Every visible node of the UI receives the keys, whether the pointer is over it or not; the release reaches every node, even hidden or disabled.
A held key sends one press and one release, never a repeat.

## Learn more

- [Keyboard](/use/learn/interactivity/keyboard/#tell-a-letter-from-its-place)

## Creation details

<a id="NodeKeyEvent-factory-create"></a>

### create

`<N extends Node> NodeKeyEvent<N> create(N node, Key physicalKey, Key key, IConsumableEvent source)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the event for a node, the place of the key and the key that the layout names.
`source` is the input that the event belongs to, or `null` for an input of its own.

## Method details

<a id="NodeKeyEvent-method-getKey"></a>

### getKey

`Key getKey()` 

Returns the key that the layout of the user names: on a French AZERTY keyboard, the key at the place of `Q` is [`Key.A`](/reference/input/key/#Key-value-A).
Use it for a shortcut.

<a id="NodeKeyEvent-method-getPhysicalKey"></a>

### getPhysicalKey

`Key getPhysicalKey()` 

Returns the place of the key on a US QWERTY keyboard, whatever the layout.
Use it for a movement, so that the keys stay under the same fingers on every layout.
